utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll make sure everyone knows the timing, and we’ll plug the gaps when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep watching for anything else we’re short on and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll spread the word and keep folks posted once you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning still works for me—let’s meet at 9 a.m. at my place and start with the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—9 a.m. at your place is clear, and keeping it to the urgent fixes sounds nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll make a short list tonight so we can get right to it on Saturday. See you at 9 a.m. at my place.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and send you a text if anything comes up. Really appreciate you being ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’m around if you need me, just keep it discreet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 9 a.m. at your place sounds good — I’ll be there with my tools. If I forget anything, just give me a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that’s the right time and spot? I just want to be sure before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep — Saturday at 9 a.m. at Eli’s place. Thanks for double-checking; if I muddle it, just remind me again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll come by around 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, see you around 10 — I’ll have the screws and check on the paint.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks — see you then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep everyone posted for 3:30 and make sure the check-ins stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out and let you know if I spot any tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’s a huge help. If you spot anything, just send it my way and I’ll make sure the team knows.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — if you’re still short on anything for the repair drive, just tell me what you need and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — we’re set on the main needs for now, but I’ll let you know if anything changes. The repair drive is focusing on tools, volunteer shifts, and keeping the sign-up list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — keep me posted, and I can still help if you end up needing any tools or a hand updating the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’m still tracking a few tools, plus screws and extra paint for the porch and fence repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can bring screws and extra paint. Do you still need any tools too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, we still need a few tools — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it — the route is still in order with your place first, then the community center on Maple, and the hardware store after that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, that sounds nicely lined up. I’ll keep an ear out for the repair drive date and what they still need, and pass it along as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — that’d be helpful. I’ll keep the route noted and wait for the date and any remaining needs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate the reminder. Just let me know when the time’s set, and I’ll try not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing — I’ll tell folks it’s at 10 a.m. and keep it to just a few trusted neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Perfect, 10 a.m. works for me — thanks for keeping it tight and letting me know. I’ll do my best not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donated items and flag anything that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — 3:30 after school pickup still works for me, and I can help sort the donated items then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, 3:30 works for me too — I’ll bring the donation labels and help sort everything then.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana — I’ll likely roll in late, but I can still help fill in whatever the repair drive is missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll jump in on whatever’s still missing.
